executiveSummary: This brief highlights multiple active and high-impact threats to critical infrastructure environments, including confirmed exploitation of PLCs and OT remote access gateways, perimeter appliance zero-days with public PoC, and targeted campaigns abusing cloud identity and collaboration platforms to gain footholds for potential IT-to-OT pivoting. Government advisories report ongoing, real-world compromise of industrial PLCs across Water/Wastewater and Energy, including malicious logic edits and HMI tampering. Immediate removal of internet exposure and integrity checks are advised Security Advisory Alert . Pre-auth RCE on NetScaler ADC/Gateway (public PoC) enables immediate perimeter compromise and credential theft, with strong implications for remote access into OT if gateways bridge into control zones Advisory . VMware vCenter CVE-2026-59310 exploitation for ESXi ransomware observed by IR teams threatens virtualization underpinnings of many industrial environments; patching and IOC hunts are urgent View Article . Weekly government bulletins include multiple OT/ICS-critical flaws (e.g., OPC UA Eclipse Milo in ICS stacks; PcVue HMI weaknesses; EV charging infrastructure RCE). Patching and segmentation should be prioritized CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin . Advanced campaigns abusing Microsoft 365/Graph and Google Apps Script blend into enterprise traffic and target sensitive sectors including nuclear-related individuals; identity hardening and egress controls are required View Article . Current 72h Outlook Elevated scanning and exploitation attempts on edge/IDP, OT-adjacent Actively Exploited Items Multiple (KEV/Advisories) Primary Risk Vectors Perimeter VPN/ADC, vCenter, PLC exposure Segmentation Priority IT/OT isolation & jump hosts

items: Gunra (Conti-lineage) targets edge devices and enterprise identity; double extortion with VM-centric encryption Security Advisory .
vCenter exploited to deploy Babuk-derived ransomware to ESXi; persistence via systemd/cron and SSO manipulation View Article .
CAV3RN/HOLLOWGRAPH abuse DNS and Google Apps Script, plus Microsoft Graph/Calendar, to blend with enterprise traffic View Article .
LAUNDRY BEAR (Void Blizzard) mass-exfiltrates Zimbra mail via XSS zero-day, maintains IMAP persistence with app passcodes Security Advisory .

relevance: Multiple items directly impact industrial control environments: Direct PLC manipulation (logic edits, alarm bypass) in Water/Wastewater and Energy poses immediate safety and operational risk Security Advisory . Perimeter RCE (NetScaler ADC/Gateway) and exploited vCenter flaws are high-probability ingress paths into IT hosting and jump hosts that often bridge to OT Advisory View Article . Core ICS protocol stacks and HMI platforms face auth and DoS issues that can enable unauthorized control or loss of view CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin .

items: OPC UA (Eclipse Milo): role/authorization bypass and DoS across 0.6.0-1.1.4 threaten ICS communications layers CISA Bulletin .
PcVue HMI: weak credential protection/credential recovery could yield privileged OT access CISA Bulletin .
EV charging infrastructure (EVbee DC-80): unauthenticated command execution and unsigned firmware enable remote manipulation/DoS CISA Bulletin .
Johnson Controls Airwall: hardcoded cryptographic key in remote access/segmentation platform; rotate keys and upgrade to v4.1.0+ ICS Advisory .
NetScaler ADC/Gateway CVE-2026-8452: unauthenticated RCE (public PoC); patch and hunt for web shells Advisory .

descriptions: Initial access via perimeter RCE and VPN/ADC appliances; router/SD-WAN abuse for covert ingress Advisory .
Persistence and privilege escalation on vCenter/ESXi via systemd/cron, SSO group manipulation (ATT&CK: T1053, T1098) View Article .
AiTM and cloud abuse: DNS-steered C2, Google Apps Script relays, Microsoft Graph/Calendar covert channels (ATT&CK: T1071, T1102) View Article .
Exfiltration and persistence via mail platform app passcodes; webmail XSS zero-day mass email exfil (ATT&CK: T1056, T1114) Security Advisory .
OT manipulation: unauthorized PLC logic/project edits, alarm disablement, mode changes; ICS protocol misuse (Modbus TCP, ENIP/CIP, S7) Security Advisory .

outlook72h: Expect scanning and exploit attempts on NetScaler ADC/Gateway SAML endpoints; maintain heightened WAF/IPS monitoring Advisory . Continue exploit activity against vCenter; pre-stage rollback plans and ensure immutable backups for vCenter/ESXi configs View Article . Watch for identity phishing/AiTM using cloud relays (Apps Script/Graph); enforce token protection/CAE and conditional access View Article .
